message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/capstonenext && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"tests/test_riscv.c","function":"test","line":79,"var":"RISCV_CODE64","code":"#define RISCV_CODE64 \"\\x13\\x04\\xa8\\x7a\\x00\\x00\\x00\\x00\"","note":"Attacker-controlled input is the 8-byte RISC-V buffer; the first 4 bytes form a valid instruction and the trailing 4 zero bytes are intended to exercise the decoder past the nominal instruction boundary."},
  {"step":2,"file":"tests/test_riscv.c","function":"test","line":95,"var":"platforms[i].code / platforms[i].size","code":"count = cs_disasm(handle, platforms[i].code, platforms[i].size, address, 0, &insn);","note":"The harness passes the crafted byte buffer and its length into Capstone's RISC-V disassembler."},
  {"step":3,"file":"arch/RISCV/RISCVDisassembler.c","function":"RISCV_getInstruction","line":null,"var":"Ptr / NumToSkip","code":"generated table-driven decoder in RISCVGenDisassemblerTables.inc uses NumToSkip = *Ptr++; NumToSkip |= (*Ptr++) << 8; NumToSkip |= (*Ptr++) << 16;","note":"The decoder consumes bytes from the input stream while interpreting table entries; malformed control flow can advance Ptr based on attacker-controlled bytes."},
  {"step":4,"file":"arch/RISCV/RISCVDisassembler.c","function":"DecodeGPRRegisterClass","line":44,"var":"RegNo","code":"if (RegNo > sizeof(GPRDecoderTable)) return MCDisassembler_Fail; Reg = GPRDecoderTable[RegNo];","note":"The bounds check compares against sizeof(array) in bytes instead of the number of elements, so an out-of-range register number can still index the decoder table."},
  {"step":5,"file":"arch/RISCV/RISCVDisassembler.c","function":"DecodeGPRRegisterClass","line":50,"var":"GPRDecoderTable[RegNo]","code":"Reg = GPRDecoderTable[RegNo];","note":"An unchecked table lookup can read past the 32-entry register mapping, producing an invalid register value that is later stored into the decoded instruction."},
  {"step":6,"file":"arch/RISCV/RISCVDisassembler.c","function":"MCOperand_CreateReg0","line":null,"var":"MCInst operand storage","code":"MCOperand_CreateReg0(Inst, Reg);","note":"The invalid register value is written into the instruction operand list, which is the memory-safety sink when the decoder has already stepped beyond the valid mapping."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print('wrote trace')
PY
